title: Fractional oscillators with fractional damping in the presence of external forces
summary: We investigate how a fractional oscillator reacts to external forces when the dynamic law includes a damping term that is explicitly fractional. We show that the corresponding three-parametric fractional differential equation (in the Caputo sense) admits formal solution. Two of the fractional parameters are associated with the intrinsic dissipation mechanism derived from the fractional nature of the oscillator.
